consumer.use: Decide whether the R3 one-slot invariant removes the exact T036/R2 contradiction without weakening interference rejection or activating a natural pilot.

decision_target.question: Does R3 state a contradiction-free invariant in which every fully provable post-A candidate_identity_birth creates exactly one fixed slot before gates, while an experiment-influenced birth consumes that one slot and contributes zero accepted natural evidence?

intervention.name: explicit one-slot-before-gates invariant
intervention.description: Construct canonical birth identity and fixed ordinal before naturalness/self-interference; explicitly forbid only zero slots for a fully proved interfered birth, while Phase G independently forbids natural-evidence acceptance.

control_condition.description: Frozen T036/R2 author head c654a3c707fc4e6aafdc0034b26e2e622e1e1054 and PR #355 result 640eca602eead54a8022ad6b8077840c29daf103c096c6d7036929c27975ace5, where exact-head review found that one sentence prohibited reading the interfered birth as one slot immediately before the protocol required exactly one consumed slot.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly R01-R09 in sampling-unit-cases.md, including frozen R03: an experiment-delayed and reprioritized fully proved post-A birth must deterministically yield assigned=1, consumed=1, accepted_natural_evidence=0 and REJECT_THIS_REVISION.

measurement.method: Freeze one author commit containing CONTEXT.md, method.md, sampling-unit-cases.md, manifest.yml and registration.v2.json while every counter-hypothesis assessment is pending/not_checked and no result verdict exists. Then require an independent reviewer to inspect that exact commit and attempt all seven preregistered counter-review attacks. No natural candidate is observed and no pilot is activated.
measurement.success: The exact-head reviewer cannot recover the R2 contradiction, cannot derive zero assigned/consumed slots for frozen R03, cannot accept natural evidence from R03, cannot move a Phase-G predicate into Phase S, cannot renumber around a rejected slot, cannot turn incomplete birth proof into a soft skip/speculative slot, and confirms that no checked/favorable review or result label existed at the frozen author head.
measurement.falsification: Any material protocol-conforming escape on the seven required attacks or any premature checked/favorable assessment/result label rejects this revision without repairing the frozen author files.

cost_metric.method: Record reviewer runtime as descriptive overhead only.

comparison.unit: three frozen R2 negative-evidence facts versus one frozen R3 protocol and nine adversarial cases
comparability_constraints: T036/R2 frozen author head c654a3c707fc4e6aafdc0034b26e2e622e1e1054, its method, registration and R01-R09 remain unchanged negative evidence
the R2 frozen sentence forbids the one-slot reading for the interfered birth
the same R2 Phase-G contract immediately requires exactly one consumed slot for that birth
the exact-head review at PR #355 records that contradiction as material and terminally rejects the revision
canonical candidate identity and authoritative event-id ordering remain unchanged
the activation boundary A and target N are not chosen here
no natural candidate is observed or consumed
review is bound to the exact frozen R3 author commit
confounders: paper agreement cannot establish live event-journal completeness
one independent reviewer may still share conceptual priors with the author
slot precision does not establish Outcome Case efficacy, prevalence or cost

allowed: frozen T036/R2 author revision and terminal rejection
future completeness-reporting Bureau event-journal receipt only for later activation

reviewed_exception.rationale: The successor is paper/adversarial-only, corrects one frozen falsified semantics seam and grants no natural-pilot or productive authority.
